note: Availability is what the model engine determined on the installation that generated this file; the running platform re-checks it at every start (Model Registry page, GET /api/v1/models).

availability_categories.available: runs on a single uploaded slice
availability_categories.requires_context: trained and loaded; needs neighbouring slices (2.5-D / 3-D / 5-slice input) — upload them too
availability_categories.missing_dependency: trained, but a required upstream artifact is not in this installation
availability_categories.missing_weights: trained, but its weight file is not in this installation
availability_categories.legacy: superseded earlier version, kept for reproducibility (not run in comparisons)
availability_categories.not_trained: registered architecture with no trained weights (never trained)
availability_categories.failed_integrity: artifact present but failed its integrity / self test
availability_categories.non_deployable: loaded but cannot produce a confident call (see reason)
